# crosswork_roles (Resource)

This resource can manage a role in the local authentication store.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "crosswork_roles" "example" {
  name = "cwtest-role"
  api_permissions = {
    "cw-fault-events-api" = "RW"
    "nso-fp-dep-mngr"     = "RWD"
  }
  task_permissions = ["id_export_audit_logs_access", "id_view_audit_logs_access", "id_nso_fp_deployment_management"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `api_permissions` (Map of String) API id with its access level: `R` read, `W` write, `D` delete. The ids are listed by the `crosswork_role_catalog` data source
  - Choices: `R`, `W`, `D`, `RW`, `RD`, `WD`, `RWD`
- `name` (String) Role name

### Optional

- `instance` (String) Select an instance of the provider configuration by its name. Leave it unset to use the default instance.
- `task_permissions` (Set of String) Task ids of the role. The ids are listed by the `crosswork_role_catalog` data source

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The id of the object

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import crosswork_roles.example "<name>"
```
